pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: An attacker hitting the Sea Viper can receive Mining Fatigue through its separate hurt response. This impairs subsequent rapid attacks and mining; watch the effect icon and bring milk. Breathing supplies and a route to the surface prevent fighting while also running out of air.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Sea Viper Trophy, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
